## TemplateEngine.\_processDivBlocks() method

Block: div Normalizes content within `<div>` blocks by removing indentation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processDivBlocks(template: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

The template with `<div>` blocks replaced by their de-indented content

## Remarks

This internal method processes `<div>` blocks and cleans their inner content by removing leading tabs/spaces per line and trimming surrounding newlines. The `<div>` tags themselves are removed from the output.

\*\*Attributes:\*\* - none

## Example


```typescript
const template = '<div>\n    Line 1\n    Line 2\n</div>';
const processed = TemplateEngine._processDivBlocks(template);
// Result: 'Line 1\nLine 2'
```
